summary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 28, 2026, as a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16. The filing contains only the cover page and an exhibit (EX-99.1) which appears to be a PDF attachment. No special situation transaction, such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review, is described in the excerpt. The filing is a standard regulatory submission with no disclosed deal terms, board recommendations, or material corporate actions.
